title: Submit valid text box form
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
testData: Full name Ada Lovelace; email ada@example.com; valid current and permanent addresses
steps: Enter Ada Lovelace in Full Name
Enter 12 Analytical Engine Road in Current Address
expected: The output panel shows the submitted name, email, and both addresses.

title: Reject invalid email
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
expected: The Email field fails HTML5 validity and no successful submission output is shown.

title: Submit name with optional fields empty
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
testData: Full name Ada Lovelace; all other fields empty
steps: Enter Ada Lovelace in Full Name
Leave Email, Current Address, and Permanent Address empty
expected: The output panel shows Name:Ada Lovelace and does not show values for empty fields.

title: Submit empty form
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
expected: The output container is present but contains no submitted field values.

title: Preserve multiline address values
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
testData: Current Address: Line 1 and Line 2; Permanent Address: Building 3 and Floor 5
steps: Enter a name and valid email
Enter two newline-separated lines in Current Address
Enter two newline-separated lines in Permanent Address
expected: Both address lines are rendered in the submission output without losing line content.

title: Reject malformed email variants
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
steps: Enter each malformed email variant separately
expected: Each malformed value fails the Email field's HTML5 validity check.

title: Accept 64-character email local part
preconditions: The Text Box page is available
steps: Enter valid current and permanent addresses
expected: The 64-character local-part email passes browser validation and appears in the output.
